location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Select the Azure region for the resource.

body.query: ResourceContainers | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | mv-expand mgChain = properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain | extend mgName = tostring(mgChain.name) | summarize matchingManagementGroups = countif(mgName matches regex '^[a-z][a-z0-9]{2,3}lz[0-9]{0,2}$') | project MSISR = todynamic(iff(matchingManagementGroups > 0, 'true', 'false'))

options.text: The values selected below will be used as components in your naming convention to name your Azure resource groups and resources.

link.label: Click here for more information on the naming convention used in this deployment.

elements.name: identifier
elements.label: Identifier
elements.toolTip: Input a 3 character identifier for the resource group and resource names created with this solution. The identifier should represent a unique value within your organization, such as a business unit or project.

constraints.validationMessage: The value must be 1 - 3 characters in length, alphanumeric, and lowercase.

elements.name: environment
elements.label: Environment Abbreviation
elements.toolTip: Select the target environment for the solution. The single letter environment abbreviation will be used as part of the naming convention for the resoure groups and resources.

options.text: Checking the box below will enable the deployment of the necessary private DNS zones to enable private access to Azure PaaS services adhering to zero trust principles. These resources will exist in the enclave's managed resource group.

link.label: Click here for more information on Azure zero trust configurations.

elements.name: zeroTrust
elements.label: Enable zero trust configurations?
elements.toolTip: Choose whether to deploy the AVD stamp in a zero trust compliant configuration.

options.text: Select the identity configuration below that matches your environment and will be used with the Azure Virtual Desktop workload deployment. Setting the appropriate identity configuration ensures the private DNS zones are created in or referenced from the correct location.

elements.name: solution
elements.label: Active Directory Solution
elements.toolTip: Choose the Active Directory solution that already exists.

options.text: Select the location for diagnostic and operating system logging data to be sent for your enclave and workload resources. This setting cannot be modified once the enclave is created.

elements.name: diagnosticDestination
elements.label: Select the Log Analytics workspace(s) for the enclave. You may select one or both options.

options.text: Select your initial network settings. AE uses private networks to isolate your workloads and enforce a security boundary. Once your enclave is created, you can centrally manage all of your connections and settings through enclave endpoints and enclave connections.

elements.name: networkSize
elements.label: Network size
elements.toolTip: Select the size of the virtual network for the enclave.

elements.name: enclaveAddressSpace
elements.label: Enclave address space
elements.toolTip: Specify an address CIDR range within the range [10,26].

validations.message: Invalid CIDR range. The address prefix must be in the range [10,24].
